timing: Instant quote and check on the spot at buying events.
who_pays: KEH Camera - the company pays you directly at the event, by check.
who_qualifies: You must own the gear, bring valid ID, and attend a scheduled KEH buying event in person.
work_available: Only at scheduled events - check the event calendar on keh.com. Miss the event day and there is no deal; events are location-limited.
what_gets_accepted: KEH appraises working photo and video gear on the spot. Anything needing repair gets marked down on the spot; KEH can decline items. Clean lenses and include caps, batteries, and hoods - completeness lifts the quote.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Your unpaid time is traveling to the event and waiting for the on-the-spot appraisal - bring everything in one trip.
when_cash_arrives: A check on the spot at the event after you accept the instant quote - deposit and clearing time is extra on top of that.
